name: blueprint/inbox-triage
description: Triage any inbox of text items: classify priority, extract the ask, board follow-ups as tasks, schedule the time-sensitive ones as reminders, and draft the reply yourself - the tools prioritize, you write.
use_cases: a pile of messages to sort
which ones need a reply today
recipe: capture -> classify priority -> extract the ask -> urgent: task + reply now; respond: task; time-sensitive: task + event at the deadline; later/ignore: receipt only -> work the board oldest-open
result_kind: priority labels + one task per actionable item + events for deadlines
cost_hint: two model calls per item (classify + extract)
pitfalls: classify is verbatim-label - closed priority set
the reply is yours to write; the tools never draft on your behalf
schedule the deadline as an event, not a task detail
ignore is a decision too - record it
